request.spec:
The header shows the signed-in user's own figures when a person on the sheet has the user's name
(by name or alias, as names are compared): that person's due-total and overdue-total; nothing when
there is no such person.

agent.result_text:
The header now shows the signed-in user's own due-total and overdue-total, and all 4 acceptance tests pass in `bin/e2e`.

**What it does:** the app looks for a person on the sheet whose name or one of whose aliases is the signed-in user's name. As the server compares names, case is ignored; I also ignore spaces at either end. If it finds one, the header shows that person's due-total in `my-due-total` and overdue-total in `my-overdue-total`. If there's no such person, both are blank.

**Where:**
- `src/main/frontend/features/header/totals.ts`: a new `useMyFigures(sheetId, user)` hook works out the two figures. It uses the same calculations as the person row's due-total and overdue-total cells, so the numbers always match those cells.
- `src/main/frontend/features/header/header.slot.tsx`: the header now receives the signed-in user's name and shows the two new values after the sheet totals.

Only the front end changed: the server already sends everything needed, so no stored data or audit records changed.
